definitions.threshold_purpose: Descriptive only; not training rules, exclusions, QC or scientific thresholds.
definitions.scene_pixel_tau_exposure: One scene, native pixel and tau in one forward; sum per-tau counts.
definitions.scene_pixel_any_tau_exposure: One scene/pixel in one forward, counted once if any tau exceeds; not 32 pixels.
definitions.per_tau_qlog_median: Lower median across all batch elements and regional pixels, inherited torch.median convention.
definitions.per_forward_max_distribution: One regional maximum over batch/pixels/taus per forward; empirical quantiles linear h=(n-1)*p.
definitions.per_tau_max_distribution: One regional spatial/batch maximum at each tau per forward; same linear empirical quantiles.
definitions.coordinate_convention: Zero-based native target row/column; frozen mask; no transpose or flip.
definitions.outside: Complement of frozen Yunnan evaluation mask within native 100x100 target grid; no IMERG-validity filter.
definitions.interpretation: Risk booleans describe only this frozen replay trajectory; not a future guarantee. Major tail concentration is described by extrema, counts and exposure fractions; no new mainly threshold is selected.
definitions.pixel_percentiles: Pooled pixel-level p99/p99.9 are not measured; only the requested per-forward maxima distributions.
